_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment (batch S6 Silver Cross). Sourced 2026-07-05. Silver Cross Comet lightweight one-seat stroller. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Silver Cross Comet

clekListed.clekRow: Silver Cross Comet — Comet car seat adapters

specs._dimsNote: Open L31.5 x W24 x H37-42 in; folded (one-piece flat fold) L34 x W24 x H13 in. Folded length exceeds open length because the seat lies flat forward.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth (included Babynest cocoon + reclining reversible seat)

specs._basketNote: Basket rated 5 kg (~11 lb) per Strollberry Comet spec sheet.

safety.standards: ASTM F833 / 16 CFR 1227 (US market). No specific standard is published on the Silver Cross US spec page; Silver Cross is UK-origin (EN 1888 in home market, not stated for US units). No named third-party certification (e.g. JPMA) published.
safety.notes: State-of-the-art harness with 'Genius' buckle; included Babynest for newborns; one-piece compact fold.

specs.recline: multi-position reclining reversible seat (rides reclined, rear- or forward-facing)

notes: Lightweight ~16 lb one-seat 'four-mode' stroller — a reasonable city/shopping candidate, heavier than the Jet but with a proper reversible seat. US supply is thinning (Baby Cubby empty at check); Bambi Baby lists $549.99 in stock. Basket capacity not published (null). Clek Liing mounts via the Comet car seat adapters ($24.99).
